collection.title: BMW X1 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW X1 2022 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW X1 2022 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
